def concatenate_tuple(input_tuple, delimiter='-'):
    """
    Concatenates each element of the input tuple using the specified delimiter.
    
    :param input_tuple: Tuple containing elements to be concatenated.
    :param delimiter: String used to join the elements of the tuple.
    :return: A string with elements of the tuple joined by the delimiter.
    """
    return delimiter.join(map(str, input_tuple))
